summary: Biomerica (BMRA) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement to sell 78,750 shares (6% stake) of Diagnosis S.A. for $500,000 aggregate to buyers affiliated with its CEO. Consideration is cash via a secured promissory note pending regulatory approval under Polish law, expected within 30 days. No board recommendation or advisor named. Upon transfer, principal and interest beyond 60 days' interest will be forgiven. The transaction is small and related-party, limiting typical arbitrage. Key watchpoints: Polish regulatory clearance timing and potential conflicts of interest given CEO affiliation.
